title: centaurea resupinata subsp. degenii
intro: Centaurea resupinata subsp. degenii, commonly known as Degen's knapweed, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It is used in traditional medicine, where it is believed to offer various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Degen's knapweed include treating gastrointestinal issues, skin conditions, and respiratory problems, with its bioactive constituents including sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. Further research is needed to fully understand the plant's potential health benefits and therapeutic applications.
